name: practice_exchange

criteria.description: Fits this buyer's business, customers and buying situation
Gives a concrete reason this buyer would benefit (margin, sell-through, project fit), not adjectives
Short, plain, easy to answer on a phone; one idea per message
Clear, low-effort next step that fits the buyer's stage
Credible, respectful and human; not pushy, generic or salesy
Answers the buyer's replies and objections directly and honestly (null if the buyer never replied)
No invented facts, fake urgency, or pressure; follows email law (identifies sender, easy opt-out)

rules: Score each criterion 0-10. If honesty is below 5 (invented facts, manipulation, or illegal practice), the total is capped at 40.
